GPTR-F-001-S118.title: Core Allowlist Enforcement Engine
GPTR-F-001-S118.description: Implement the server-side enforcement engine that evaluates incoming GPTReader requests against the allowlist schema, validating collection access, field-level restrictions, query operators, and result limits before execution.

GPTR-F-001-S119.title: Request Interception and Validation Hook
GPTR-F-001-S119.description: Integrate enforcement into the GPTReader request lifecycle by adding a pre-execution validation hook that intercepts all inbound requests and routes them through the allowlist engine before any database interaction.

GPTR-F-001-S120.title: Unit and Negative Test Coverage for Enforcement
GPTR-F-001-S120.description: Develop comprehensive unit tests and negative test cases to validate allowlist enforcement behavior, including rejection of unauthorized collections, fields, malformed queries, and limit violations.

GPTR-F-001-S121.title: Integration with Existing Query Execution Path
GPTR-F-001-S121.description: Ensure enforced requests seamlessly integrate with existing GPTReader query execution logic, preserving current response formats, pagination limits, and performance constraints without bypass paths.
